prompt_set.common: Original male portrait is the authoritative painting style and natural masculine anatomy reference; original isolated part is the material reference. Chinese ink and light watercolour, matte charcoal strokes, warm grey-brown hues, subtle paper wash. Strict frontal view, equal left/right height; one pair in one row on transparent canvas. No jagged corners, angry scowl, face, skin plate, other features, background or labels.
prompt_set.eyes: Only eyeballs, lids and complete short upper lashes with sparse lower lashes. Soft rounded almond curves and corners; grey-brown small natural irises, direct gaze, matching restrained iris lights. No detached highlights, opaque eye-socket complexion, brows or heavy eyeliner.
prompt_set.eyebrows: Only eyebrows, moderately full but softly curving masculine shapes, feathered inner heads and naturally tapered fine-hair tails. No knife shape, hard triangle, black geometric bar, skin, eyes or scalp hair.
prompt_set.ningyue: Calm gently curved almond eyes and nearly straight softly curving brows, rounded tails.
prompt_set.panshi: Warm composed slightly fuller almond eyes and full low broad gentle brow arc with individual irregular hair strokes.
prompt_set.lingfeng: Alert graceful almond eyes, short soft uplifted outer corner; mildly rising brows with low rounded peak and fine-hair taper.
